title: A delivered context carries its provenance; a project holding it reads its own
situation: The architect restated the concepts as name and differentia and cut implementation from them; this behaviour, which the concepts carried before, is recorded here so it stays bound.
decision: A delivered context carries its origin, its release's version and its identity, the id of the entry that first recorded it; a project whose journal holds an entry with that identity reads the context as its own, part of its design, and the delivered copy is not shown apart.
consequences: Cratylus's own repository reads its workflow context from its journal; every other project reads it as delivered, read-only.
